dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows several tags or chips as one set — the tags of an article, the filters above a list, a few suggestions under a field — and decides once how far apart the members of such a set stand along a line and how far apart its lines stand when the set wraps: closer for static tags, and for chips far enough that each keeps its whole touch target — and how a member moves to its new place when the set is laid out again.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a tag group reads: for each spacing (tags, chips) the distance between two members on a line and the distance between two lines, and the motion that moves a member to its new place when the set is laid out again. The tags and chips inside keep their own tokens.
rules: A tag group lays out a set of tags or chips in lines that wrap, and exposes it as one list. It draws nothing of its own: no container, no label, no divider.
Set spacing to chips for a set whose members take input; row-gap.chips is what keeps each chip's touch target whole between two lines.
Give every member of a group the same size; the group has no size of its own.
The group keeps no selection and handles no key: each chip is its own Tab stop and holds its own state. One choice among several is a radio group, tabs or a segmented button.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never restyle the members from the group.

gap.$description: Distance between the visible bounds of two neighbouring members on one line, per spacing. Neighbouring hit areas meet at the middle of it (TGR-5).

row-gap.$description: Distance between two lines of a group that wraps, per spacing. For tags it is the gap along the line, so that a wrapped set reads as one block. For chips it is what keeps each chip's target whole between two lines: at sys.target.touch minus a chip's height or more, no hit areas overlap. The default system's 16 is 48 minus a medium chip's 32.

move-duration.$description: How long a member takes to move to its new place when a member is added, removed or changes its size and the set is laid out again (TGR-10): along its line, or from one line to another. Longer than a change of color: the member crosses the length of a neighbour, or a whole line.
